t:
杜纳，那颗红色的斑点，反差的代名词。让我们揭开这个天体的神秘面纱吧？

打开地图视图，将视角切换至杜纳（按 [Tab] 键轮换）。当杜纳被选定时，通过屏幕右侧的行星图标进入信息库。

如你所见，我们为这次任务选择杜纳的原因之一在于它的环境条件：它拥有相对稀薄的大气层，引力也比坎巴拉小得多，因此即使对于新手来说，这应该也是一个足够简单的任务。

n: Execute that burn, if you do everything correctly you should see the encounter node even after removing the maneuver node. If not I recommend you set up another correction maneuver as soon as possible, the closer you are to the Celestial Body you want to reach the more dV it takes to correct the course. Besides that all that's left is to wait until you reach your close encounter, if you want to go crazy with the Time Warp go ahead, but make sure to stop it a little before the encounter node, you could miss your encounter altogether if you're not careful.
s:
Execute that burn, if you do everything correctly you should see the encounter node even after removing the maneuver node. If not I recommend you set up another correction maneuver as soon as possible, the closer you are to the Celestial Body you want to reach the more dV it takes to correct the course.

Besides that all that's left is to wait until you reach your close encounter, if you want to go crazy with the Time Warp go ahead, but make sure to stop it a little before the encounter node, you could miss your encounter altogether if you're not careful.

执行该次点火。如果一切操作正确，即使删除机动节点后，你仍应能看到交会节点。如果没看到，建议你尽快设置另一次修正机动；距离想要到达的天体越近，修正航向所需的Δv就越多。

除此以外，剩下的就是等待接近交会点。如果你想尽情使用时间加速也没问题，但请确保在交会节点前一点停下加速；稍不留神你可能就会彻底错过交会。

n: So you've gotten to the Mun already, right? That's good, but it's easy, we're going to go over a more complex procedure today, getting to another planet directly from a low Kerbin orbit. The difficulty of the task depends a lot on the planet you intend to visit. One obvious reason is that farther Celestial Bodies need more dV to be reached, but you also have to take the CB's characteristics into account, such as atmosphere, gravity and the like. So when choosing a planet to visit your first stop should be the Tracking Station's Knowledge Base. Here you can learn more about each CB and see if you're up to the task, but for today there's no need because I know where we're going: Duna.

t:
你已经去过穆恩了，对吧？干得漂亮，但那还算简单。今天我们要学习一个更复杂的过程：直接从坎巴拉低轨道出发前往另一颗行星。任务的难度很大程度上取决于你打算访问的行星。显而易见的一个原因是前往更遥远的天体需要更多Δv，但你还必须考虑天体的物理特性，比如大气层、重力等。

因此，在选择要访问的行星时，你的第一站应该是深空追踪站的信息库。在这里你可以了解每个天体的详细信息，评估自己是否能胜任这项任务。不过今天没必要看，因为我已经选好目标了：杜纳。

n: It's time for a little lecture, in order to make our transfer to Duna, or any other CB for that matter, we're going to use something called the Oberth effect. The Periapsis is the lowest point in an orbit, and the Apoapsis the highest one, remember? Well, think about your orbit as a hill for a moment, if you're going uphill it's harder than going downhill, right? This is because your kinetic energy is lower when you're traveling to a higher point, so going back to orbits the point of highest kinetic energy of the orbit is the Periapsis, because it's where you're about to change from downhill to uphill. You may ask yourself what all this has to do with getting to Duna, well back to the hill analogy, you get tired less if you run downhill, you use less energy, it's the same here, you burn less fuel if your kinetic energy is at its highest.
s:
It's time for a little lecture, in order to make our transfer to Duna, or any other CB for that matter, we're going to use something called the Oberth effect.

The Periapsis is the lowest point in an orbit, and the Apoapsis the highest one, remember? Well, think about your orbit as a hill for a moment, if you're going uphill it's harder than going downhill, right? This is because your kinetic energy is lower when you're traveling to a higher point, so going back to orbits the point of highest kinetic energy of the orbit is the Periapsis, because it's where you're about to change from downhill to uphill.

You may ask yourself what all this has to do with getting to Duna, well back to the hill analogy, you get tired less if you run downhill, you use less energy, it's the same here, you burn less fuel if your kinetic energy is at its highest.
t:
现在来进行一段简短讲解。为了向杜纳（或任何其他天体）进行转移，我们将利用所谓的奥伯特效应。

近地点是轨道上的最低点，而远地点是最高点，还记得吗？不妨把你的轨道想象成一座小山，上坡总比下坡费力，对吧？这是因为当你向更高处运动时动能会降低。回到轨道力学中，轨道上动能最高的点就是近地点，因为这里正是由下坡转为上坡的临界点。

你可能会问，这和前往杜纳有什么关系？回到爬山的类比，下坡跑时你消耗的体力更少、消耗的能量更低；轨道也是同理，在动能最高时进行点火，消耗的燃料最少。

n: You are now on Duna's close proximity, but you're not done yet, a few things could have gone a little wrong. One thing that happens often is that Ike, Duna's satellite, is in the way, your trajectory leads to an Ike encounter. This is common because Ike's SOI is actually bigger than Duna's. If this happens create a maneuver node as close as possible to your current position and move the Radial vector a little away from Duna, burn and wait until you are close to Ike's orbit, then create another maneuver to get back closer to Duna. In any case create a node and pull the retrograde vector to create a stable low orbit around Duna, this will give us a better chance of success. This is not mandatory, if you're full of daring and/or can't spare the fuel you could set a collision course and proceed to land.
s:
You are now on Duna's close proximity, but you're not done yet, a few things could have gone a little wrong.

One thing that happens often is that Ike, Duna's satellite, is in the way, your trajectory leads to an Ike encounter. This is common because Ike's SOI is actually bigger than Duna's. If this happens create a maneuver node as close as possible to your current position and move the Radial vector a little away from Duna, burn and wait until you are close to Ike's orbit, then create another maneuver to get back closer to Duna.

In any case create a node and pull the retrograde vector to create a stable low orbit around Duna, this will give us a better chance of success. This is not mandatory, if you're full of daring and/or can't spare the fuel you could set a collision course and proceed to land.
t:
你现在已经非常接近杜纳了，但任务还没有结束，仍有一些情况可能会出差错。

最常见的问题之一就是杜纳的卫星艾克挡在了路上，你的轨迹可能会遭遇艾克。这种情况很常见，因为艾克的引力范围实际上比杜纳还要大。如果发生这种情况，在尽可能靠近当前位置的地方创建一个机动节点，并将径向矢量向远离杜纳的方向微调，点火并等待接近艾克轨道，然后创建另一个机动以重新靠近杜纳。

无论如何，请创建一个节点并向后拉动逆行矢量，建立一个稳定的杜纳低轨道，这将提高我们的成功率。这并非强制要求，如果你胆识过人并且/或者燃料不足，也可以直接设定撞击航向并进行着陆。
